body.error: Content is too large to export (max 1048576 bytes)

note: Size measured in UTF-8 encoded bytes, cap 1048576 (1 MiB). Request body elided here: content was 'A' * 1048577. contract change 2026-08-17: the route now requires auth, so this 413 is only reachable with credentials — a credential-less call takes the 401 in export_pdf_post_401.json first. The transport-level DefaultBodyLimit (8 MiB) sits above this content cap so the recorded 413 body is what an over-cap payload actually gets.
